## Project workspace: done and verified

The full §6.3 workspace is built in `/opt/nxeon-workspace/web/src/features/workspace/`. `WorkspacePage.tsx` default-exports `WorkspacePage` (the router lazy-loads it at `/p/:slug/*`).

**Verification:**
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` passes for the whole repo.
- `npx vite build` passes for the full app now that the admin files exist.
- Reducer tests pass 5/5: `node --test src/features/workspace/reducer.test.mjs`. Node 22 strips the types itself, so nothing was installed.
- No new dependencies in `web/`.
- I tested the page against a mock API + WebSocket server with headless Chromium, in dev and in a production build. A production build makes no requests to any outside host. Monaco is bundled locally with Vite `?worker` workers and loads in about 1s. ⌘S save works.
- Exercised end to end: a simulated live run (thinking, text, tools, todos, file changes, suggestions), the "updated by Claude" flash in the editor, a dirty open file, uploads, the drop overlay, the mic (fake audio device → `/api/transcribe` → text inserted), slash commands, the mode/model menus, the preview logs drawer, mobile tabs, viewer mode and the usage-limit error.

**Things to know:**
- **UI kit not used.** `@/components/ui` didn't exist when I started, so the folder has its own small components (`ui.tsx`). The page does not depend on the shared kit.
- **Shared scratchpad.** The scratchpad directory is shared by all agents. Another agent overwrote my first `pw/` files, so I moved to `scratchpad/nxw-ws/`.
- **System packages installed.** Headless Chromium needed system libraries, so I ran `sudo npx playwright install-deps chromium` (apt packages on the VPS).

**Files:**
- `store.ts`: zustand store. Handles project loading, conversations, messages, runs, sending, uploads, file tree, editor tabs, preview, layout state, and remembers per-project choices.
- `reducer.ts`: the pure `applyRunEvent(state, event, now)`, plus helpers (final-answer split, suggestion-tag stripping, edit line counts, line diff, thinking one-liner).
- `toolFormat.ts`: plain-language tool descriptions (Read, Edit/MultiEdit/Write with +/- counts, Bash, Grep/Glob, web tools, TodoWrite, Task/Agent, MCP) and language detection.
- `Chat.tsx`, `AssistantMessage.tsx`, `Markdown.tsx`: the message view.
- `PromptBox.tsx`, `Mic.tsx`: prompt box, slash commands, model/mode/thinking menus, recording.
- `LeftRail.tsx`: file tree and conversations list.
- `PreviewPane.tsx`, `CodePane.tsx` (lazy-loaded), `monacoSetup.ts`, `workspace.css` (all classes prefixed `.nxw-`).

## API calls and payloads I rely on (for reconciling the backend)
Every response parser accepts either a bare array/object or a wrapped key (`{projects}`, `{conversations}`, `{messages}`, `{models}`, `{project}`, `{conversation}`, `{upload}`, `{tree}`).
- `GET /api/projects` → match by `slug`, then `GET /api/projects/:id`. `myRole === 'viewer'` makes everything read-only.
- `GET /api/models`, `GET /api/usage/me` (`today.inputTokens/outputTokens/runs`, `limits.dailyTokens`).
- `GET/POST /api/projects/:id/conversations`. POST body is `{title, model, mode}` and returns a Conversation. `PATCH /api/conversations/:id {title}`, `DELETE /api/conversations/:id`.
- `GET /api/conversations/:id/messages` → `Message[]`. Assistant messages carry `runId`, `run`, `events:[{seq,type,data,ts?}]` and `suggestions`. A user message with a `runId` but no assistant message yet gets a placeholder. Event timestamps (`ts`) are optional; without them, "Thought for Xs" in old messages falls back to plain "Thought".
- `POST /api/conversations/:id/prompt {text, attachments:[uploadId], model, mode, thinking}` → `{runId, messageId}`, then `live.subRun(runId, 0)`. A 429, or an error code/message containing limit/quota/budget/exceed, shows the "Usage limit reached" banner.
- `POST /api/runs/:id/abort`.
- `POST /api/uploads` (multipart `file`, `projectId`) → `{id, filename, mime, size, url, thumbUrl?}`.
- `POST /api/transcribe` (multipart `audio`, webm/opus) → `{text}`.
- Files:
  - `GET .../files/tree` accepts `FileNode[]`, `{tree}`, or a root node with `children`.
  - `GET .../files/content?path=` → `{content, binary?}` or plain text.
  - `PUT .../files/content {path, content}`; creating a new file is a PUT with empty content.
  - `POST .../files/rename {from, to}`, `.../files/delete {path}`, `.../files/mkdir {path}`.
  - `GET .../files/download?path=` is used for downloads and image previews.
- Preview: `GET .../preview/status` → `PreviewStatus` (`running, port, pid, logTail`); `POST .../preview/start|stop`. The iframe loads `/preview/<slug>/<subPath>`.
- WebSocket messages handled: `run_event`, `run_status`, `suggestions`, `file_change` (path relative to the project root), `preview_status`. I use `live.subProject` and `live.onStatus`.
- Every changed file triggers a full tree refetch (debounced 250ms) because the API has no per-folder endpoint.

## Screenshots
In `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-claude/a5a0e1b8-f10f-4557-a424-37ef9c870766/scratchpad/nxw-ws/shots/`:
- `01-history.png`, `02-history-expanded.png`, `20-tool-details.png`: past messages and expanded tool output
- `12-thinking-stream.png`, `13-live-05.png`, `13-live-11.png`: live run, including the editor flash on a file Claude changed
- `11-empty.png`, `21-slash.png`, `09-mode.png`, `23-drop.png`, `24-attachments.png`, `25-mic.png`, `26-mic-done.png`, `27-logs.png`
- `28-mobile-chat.png`, `10-mobile.png`, `30-prod-code-dirty.png`, `32-limit.png`, `32-viewer.png`

The mock server, harness and scripts are in the same `nxw-ws/` folder.

## Known gaps
- The editor has no explicit read-only toggle for editors; it is read-only only for viewers.
- File and folder delete use `window.confirm`.
- Diff highlighting only covers the latest external change to an open file.
- The tree has no drag-and-drop moving (dragging a file only sets its path as text).
- Sending is blocked while a run is in progress (you can type ahead, but there's no queue).
- Slash `/clear` does the same as `/new`.
- The Monaco chunk is large (about 2.7 MB for the editor core and 1.3 MB for the Code pane) but loads only when the Code tab opens. The main workspace chunk is about 480 KB, mostly highlight.js languages.
- Choices remembered per project (model/mode/thinking, preview options) and panel sizes per user are stored in browser `localStorage` only.
